theme: A wide-open day — nothing on the calendar.
greeting: Good morning, Dan — the calendar is completely clear today and tomorrow. It's a rare open stretch to spend on the few things that have quietly slipped past their dates.

needsAttention.title: CIFIC recruiter is waiting on you
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani wrote Oct 15 that he's leading the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search and offered to discuss it — a warm reply has been open since.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 task to reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is weeks overdue, and that rental is the thinnest in the market — it sells out.

needsAttention.title: December break slipped its book-by date
needsAttention.detail: The plan was to book the three-week holiday trip for all four girls by Oct 15 — now four days past, with holiday inventory for six the hardest of the year to find.

flagged.title: A provider message is waiting
flagged.detail: Your clinician left a note in the Healow patient portal on Oct 16.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club call forming
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano and the Tokyo group are setting a meeting for the week of Nov 2; you're cc'd.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, LinkedIn job alerts, travel confirmations, and St. Pete real-estate listings.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are at their crisp, tart peak now — worth folding into a rustic free-form tart.

acts.line: The calendar is empty straight through — the widest, quietest block you'll get all week.
Still nothing booked, so the afternoon is yours to point at whatever needs real focus.
A calm close at home with the girls, and tomorrow's calendar is just as clear.
